MINUTES OF AUGUST 5, 2022
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Ding called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 8:34
  A.M. on Friday, August 5, 2022, in the Mission Playhouse Lobby, 320 S. Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, Cal ifornia, 91776.

  ROLL CALL
  Council Members Present:  Denise Menchaca, Carina Rivera, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  John R. Harrington, and Mayor Tony Ding.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Martin Koczanowicz, Community Services Director
  Rebecca Perez, Police Chief Eugene Harris, Ch ief City
  Clerk Sharon Clark, Public Works Director/City Engineer
  Greg de Vinck, Fire Chief Steven Wallace, Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  Finance Director William Kaholokula, and Community

I  1. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Development Director Aldo Cervantes.

  There was no public comment.

  2. STRATEGIC PLANNING SESSION

  City Manager Lazzaretto introduced facilitator Patrick Ibarra of the Mejorando Group.

  Discussion included benefits of good government; legacy goals; governing body and
  team effectiveness; and enhancing credibility as a governing body.

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

  The meeting was recessed at 9:45 A.M . and reconvened at 9:59 A.M . with all Council
  Members present.

  STRATEGIC PLANNING SESSION (continued)

I  Discussion continued on strategies for creating a more collaborative governing body;
  and the roles of elected officials, city manager, department directors, city staff, and
  community members.

  City Manager Lazzaretto provided an update on accomplishments ach ieved in Fiscal
  Years 2020-2022 and initiatives in progress.

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

  CITY COUNCIL SPEC IAL MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 2  August 5, 2022
   The meeting was recessed at 11 :39 A.M. and reconvened at 12:34 P.M. with all Council
  Members present.

  STRATEGIC PLANNING SESSION (continued)

  Discussion continued on various aspects and trends that inform the needs of the
  community; strategic planning as a concept and application; and review and
  refinement of the City's vision and mission statements.

  RECESS AND RECONVENE
I  The meeting was recessed at 1:37. P.M. and reconvened at 1:42 P.M. with all Council
  Members present.

  Discussion continued on proposed strategic directives as follows:

  1. Build and improve the City's infrastructure:
  a. Transportation
  b. Traffic signalization
  c. Street repairs
  d. Repair of swimming pool
  2. Generate economic development by fostering a business-friendly environment.
  3. Engage the community to foster civic pride and ownership:
  a. Communication with residents
  b. Monument for veterans

I  c.  Historic preservation
  There was a consensus of the City Council to agendize overnight parking and business-
  friendly discussions for future City Council meetings.

  3. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 3:42 P.M.

  Respectfully submitted :

  Approved this 6 th day of September 2022:

I  ~~~
  TONY DI NG, Mayor
